## Credited prior resolution

Accept **30000391 / OWR-1183-011** for every positive finite dimension by Jonathan David Farley's [Theorem 11](https://ajc.maths.uq.edu.au/pdf/82/ajc_v82_p228.pdf), *A question of Björner from 1981: Infinite geometric lattices of finite rank have matchings*, Australasian Journal of Combinatorics 82(3) (2022), 228-236. The original question is Anders Björner's *Matching points to hyperplanes*, [Oberwolfach Report 1/2006](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46029?nt=1), printed pages 51-52.

The authored applicability certificate and internal mathematical proof audit are **AI-assisted and unrefereed**. Farley's prior theorem remains a published journal article. This edition records **zero new proof-search turns** and makes no novelty or first-proof claim. Credit for the general matching theorem remains with Farley and the earlier authors he cites.

## Exact accepted scope

For every positive finite integer d and every P subset R^d with aff(P)=R^d, there is an injection assigning each point a P-spanned affine hyperplane incident with that point. Arbitrary infinite cardinality, including singular cardinality, is covered in ZFC without CH, regularity or general position.

The complete affine-flat construction, rank d+1 calculation, atom identification, coatom-to-hyperplane bijection and injectivity back-transfer are retained. The d=1 singleton matching and the counterexample without affine spanning remain explicit. The literal d=0 extension is false because the singleton R^0 has no incident hyperplane, so the accepted statement requires d>=1.

The full internal audit checks Lemmas 1 and 9, Proposition 10 and Theorem 11, including finite generation at the countable closure step, uniform bounds at singular cofinality, saturation of the obstruction, minimal-cardinality/minimal-rank induction, and both final geometric cases. This is an audit relative to explicitly named external inputs, not a recursive audit of all imported references. No bijective matching, measurable or definable choice, infinite-dimensional extension, choice-free theorem or disjoint-maximal-chain result is claimed.

## Publication contents

Adds exactly eight files under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30000391/: README.md, APPLICABILITY_CERTIFICATE.md, INTERNAL_PROOF_AUDIT.md, ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md, SOURCE_LEDGER.md, SOURCE_LEDGER.json, STATUS.json and MANIFEST.json. No QUEUE.md edit is included.

The source ledgers preserve public scholarly-source titles and URLs, PDF hashes and byte counts, public publication status, and the originating audit's retrieval and inspection history. Preparing the edition adds no new source reading.

Edition manifest SHA-256: c88e793319f6210376e63aed5a2aaeb4ebdb747a9bff1ac90be4af13e19f522a.
